CustomField.inlineHelpText:
Have we used and tailored the correct template to the specific case, and removed irrelevant information?
In tailoring the template have we removed irrelevant paragraphs and added additional relevant paragraphs.
Eg: A template is used appropriately but contains several standard paragraphs that may not suit the facts of the complaint.
Eg: We have added an apology or acknowledgement of the emotional impact of the complaint beyond the standard template wording.
CustomField.label: Correct template used/tailored to case
